UseContext.SourceString: 角色等级经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase character level.

UseContext.SourceString: 经过特殊处理的，格外坚韧的棉线，轻便实用，似乎可以承受相当大的负荷。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A ball of yarn processed specially, becoming extra tough, light, and easy to use. It looks like it can bear much weight.

Description.SourceString: 绵们引以为傲的发明，即使是大力绵也无法将其扯断，但如果使用剪刀的话……还是不要有这种想法比较好。
Description.LocalizedString: Fuzzies are proud of this invention. Not even strong Fuzzies can break them. But if you use a pair of scissors… You shouldn't have dangerous thoughts like these.

UseContext.SourceString: 外形破旧的机械齿轮，恰当安置在某处的话说不定能继续发挥原本的作用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A worn-out mechanical gear. Put it in the right place, and it just might still do the job it was made for.

Description.SourceString: 似乎是很久以前从某个机器上拆下的老旧齿轮，但商绵认为，不管旧齿轮还是新齿轮，只要能用就是好齿轮。
Description.LocalizedString: Looks like an old gear stripped off some machine long ago, but the Fuzzy Merchant believes that whether it's old or new, a working gear is a good gear.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：所谓兵行险着，最危险的计划往往就是最安全的计划」。
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: Bold pawns win wars. The boldest strategy is often the safest play."

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：畅通无阻不只是车的特性，也是沃伦金币的特性」。
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: Rooks are heavy. So are Warren Gold Coins."

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：能越过他人的不只是马，还有计谋」
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: Knights aren't the only ones who can leap over opponents. Strategies can too."

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：贵族也需要卖得贵一些」
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: Nobles should sell for a noble price."

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：贵族也需要卖得贵一些」
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: Nobles should sell for a noble price."

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「后翼弃绵」玩法中使用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use it in The Fuzzy's Gambit.

Description.SourceString: 「棋圣绵的制胜秘诀：一切的终结和开始，这一盘大棋终于要收尾了！」
Description.LocalizedString: "Grandmaster Fuzzy's Secret to Victory: The end and the beginning of all things, this grand chess game is finally reaching its conclusion!"

UseContext.SourceString:
稀有的菇，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后复活选中角色，并额外恢复10000生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A rare mushroom. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to resurrect the selected character and restore an additional 10,000 HP.

Description.SourceString: 「勇者，前有发光的菇！」
Description.LocalizedString: "Adventurer, glowing mushroom ahead!"

UseContext.SourceString: 奇妙的结晶体，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A wondrous crystal. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 「流淌着的熔岩巧克力展现出邪恶的诱惑力，外壳却坚不可摧。如此美味却不可食用无法接近，有没有让勇者大人回忆起自己的人生。」
Description.LocalizedString: Flowing with lava chocolate that radiates wicked temptation, yet encased in an impenetrable shell. So delicious yet impossible to eat or even approach. Does this remind you of your own life, brave adventurer?

UseContext.SourceString: 奇妙的叶子，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A wondrous leaf. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 「完全没有用的叶子但却长得到处都是，只要它占满人们的视线，总有一天所有人都会爱上灰烬叶的。」
Description.LocalizedString: These useless leaves grow everywhere. As long as people see them all the time, one day, everyone will fall in love with the Ash Leaves.

UseContext.SourceString: 奇妙的结晶体，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A wondrous crystal. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 「有感于落月骑士的悲情，花草亦为之垂泪——这是绵绵们口耳相传的故事。正因如此绵绵们不会食用这种枯枝。本来就不能食用吧！」
Description.LocalizedString: Upon hearing the tragic story of the Falling Moon Knight, even flowers and grass shed tears—or so that's what the Fuzzies tell themselves. And that's why Fuzzies never eat these withered branches. Not that they could eat them in the first place!

UseContext.SourceString: 奇妙的结晶体，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A wondrous crystal. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 「冰晶包裹着夹心，外壳却坚不可摧。如此美味却不可食用，好可惜！」
Description.LocalizedString: A delicious filling wrapped in ice crystals, with an impenetrable exterior. So tasty, yet impossible to eat. What a shame!

UseContext.SourceString: 奇妙的植物，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A wondrous plant. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 「有感于落月骑士的悲情，花草亦为之垂泪——这是绵绵们口耳相传的故事。正因如此绵绵们不会食用这种花草。你说可能是有毒？那听起来也太不浪漫了吧！」
Description.LocalizedString: Upon hearing the tragic story of the Falling Moon Knight, even flowers and grass shed tears—or so that's what the Fuzzies tell themselves. And that's why Fuzzies never eat this plant. You think it's because the plant is poisonous? Have some imagination!

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的菇，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后全队暴击率提升30%，持续15秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous mushroom. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to increase all allies' Crit Rate by 30% for 15s.

Description.SourceString: 「勇者，前有辣菇。」
Description.LocalizedString: Hero, there's a Spicy Fungi ahead.

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的菇，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后15秒内，全队攻击命中有50%概率使目标缓速50%，缓速持续3秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous mushroom. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to grant all allies' attacks a 50% chance to slow the target by 50% for 3s for the next 15s.

Description.SourceString: 「勇者，前有美丽的菇。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Adventurer, fascinating mushroom ahead!"

ItemName.LocalizedString: Flower of the Falling Moon Knight

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的花，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后回复全队3000点生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous flower. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to restore 3,000 HP to all allies.

Description.SourceString: 「很久很久以前，落月骑士与同伴分别踏上旅途，殒命于此，思而不得的泪水化作这片湖泊——这是绵绵们口耳相传的故事。怎么可能，设定上这可是糖浆湖啊。」
Description.LocalizedString: Once upon a time, the Falling Moon Knight parted ways with their friends, only to meet their own end here. Tears of their yearning thus flowed and formed this very lake—or so that's what the Fuzzies tell themselves. Wait, how's that possible? The lake is made of sugar!

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的果实，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后全队攻击无视目标30%防御，持续15秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous fruit. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to allow all allies' attacks ignore 30% of the target's DEF for 15s.

Description.SourceString: 「味道寡淡到让人怀疑自己的味蕾。刚刚真的咬了一口果实吗？还是说，只是大咬了一口空气中的迷雾？」
Description.LocalizedString: The taste is so bland, it makes you doubt your own taste buds. Did you really take a bite of the fruit? Or did you just gobble a mouthful of mist in the air?

ItemName.LocalizedString: Flower of the Full Moon Knight

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的花，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后回复全队10000点生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous flower. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to restore 10,000 HP to all allies.

Description.SourceString: 「很久很久以前，满月骑士与同伴分别踏上旅途，殒命于此，思而不得的遗憾弥漫整座山脉——这是绵绵们口耳相传的故事。怎么可能！这里明明是我家啊——赤龙如是说道。」
Description.LocalizedString: Once upon a time, the Full Moon Knight parted ways with their friends, only to meet their own end here. Traces of regret thus linger around the entire mountain—or so that's what the Fuzzies tell themselves. "Heh, that's can't be true!" said the Crimson Dragon, "…I've always lived here!"

UseContext.SourceString:
奇妙的花，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易。
食用后全队获得相当于食用者50%生命值的护盾，持续15秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A wondrous flower. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.
Consume to grant all allies a shield equal to 50% of the user's HP for 15s.

Description.SourceString: 「原初骑士的象征之花，听闻初始骑士的性质更接近生命——刚刚那句话是谁说的？」
Description.LocalizedString: The flower that symbolizes the primal knight. They say the primal knight's essence is close to life itself—wait, who said that?

UseContext.SourceString: 开启咩之黑暗地牢的所需道具。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Required item to unlock Baaastille.

Description.SourceString: 可以用来敲打不太听话的绵的脑袋。这是赶绵杖，不是擀面杖咩！
Description.LocalizedString: Useful for bonking disobedient Fuzzies on the head. It's a Fuzzy-rolling pin, not a dough-rolling pin, baa!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后，回复全队100点充能值；增强效果额外回复全队100点环合值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Restores 100 Charge to all allies. Enhanced Effect: Restores 100 Cycle Energy to all allies.

Description.SourceString:
「传闻某绵喝完以后，腰不酸了腿不痛了，连呆毛都飞起来了咩。」
「嗯……有个朋友是这么说的。」
Description.LocalizedString:
"Rumor has it, a certain Fuzzy drank this and their back stopped aching, their legs stopped hurting, and even their ahoge started floating. Bah!" 
 "Umm… at least that's what mah friend told meh."

UseContext.LocalizedString: A rare butterfly found in scorching lands. Its fiery wings shimmer with fierce beauty, light as a feather. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant—and under the right circumstances, may awaken a touch of magic.

Description.SourceString: 扑火的飞蛾义无反顾地投身焰流，火山便给予了它灼热的祝福。
Description.LocalizedString: Like a moth to flame, it dives without hesitation into the blazing current, and the volcano marks it with a searing blessing.

UseContext.SourceString: 生活在寒冷地区的特殊蝴蝶，闪亮美丽，身体轻盈，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易，在某些情况下说不定能发挥神奇的作用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A rare butterfly native to cold regions, with shimmering, ice-blue wings as beautiful as they are weightless. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant—and under the right circumstances, may awaken a touch of magic.

Description.SourceString: 传说在雪山迷途的生灵，其愿望会化作冰蓝的蝴蝶，将旅者指引向它们到达不了的春天。
Description.LocalizedString: Legends tell that the wishes of those who vanish in the snowy mountains become ice-blue butterflies, forever guiding travelers toward an unreachable spring.

UseContext.SourceString: 生活在潮湿地区的特殊蝴蝶，闪亮美丽，身体轻盈，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易，在某些情况下说不定能发挥神奇的作用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A rare butterfly found in humid lands. Bright, beautiful, and feather-light, it glimmers like a living gem. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant—and under the right circumstances, may awaken a touch of magic.

Description.SourceString: 终其一生都在扇动潮湿的翅膀，就此拥有了飞得更高更远的力量。
Description.LocalizedString: All its life, it beats damp wings against the wind, growing strong enough to soar higher and farther than before.

UseContext.SourceString: 生活在阴暗地区的特殊蝴蝶，闪亮美丽，身体轻盈，可用于与「神秘商绵」交易，在某些情况下说不定能发挥神奇的作用。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A rare butterfly found where darkness gathers, with shimmering wings as beautiful as they are feather-light. It can be traded with the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant—and under the right circumstances, may awaken a touch of magic.

Description.SourceString: 越是黑暗的地方，微小的光亮越是可贵。
Description.LocalizedString: In the deepest darkness, even the faintest light is a treasure.

UseContext.SourceString: 养成消耗的基础货币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Basic currency for character and item upgrades.

Description.SourceString: 一种弱小到处在食物链底端的生物类异象，形似一只小小的甲壳虫，为求生存会在城市中拟态成硬币外观与碰撞声响等待被人捡起，在流通中寻找更好的生机。
Description.LocalizedString: A Bio Anomaly shaped like a small beetle, which is weak and at the bottom of the food chain. To survive in the city, it transforms into a coin upon the sound of collision, lying in wait to be picked up and thereby stands a better chance of survival through circulation.
